verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance does ship automations, such as automatic annual report filing and propagating Company Profile updates across jurisdictions, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows user-defined automations that can be versioned, reviewed before changes take effect, or rolled back. The API docs cover auth, rate limits and idempotency, which are adjacent building blocks rather than automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
